title: Implement pcapng packet capture
description: Create python/src/lichen/sim/pcap.py. PcapngWriter class: __init__(path), write_shb() (Section Header Block), write_idb() (Interface Description Block with DLT_USER0, name='lichen-lora', custom options for SF/BW/CR), write_epb(timestamp_us, data, rssi, snr, src_node, dst_node) (Enhanced Packet Block with custom options). Use struct for binary packing. Follow pcapng spec (IETF draft-tuexen-opsawg-pcapng). Integration with Medium to capture all TX/RX events. Unit test: write file, verify with tshark -r.
notes: 2026-08-27 completed pcapng hardening in python/src/lichen/sim/pcap.py with focused coverage in python/tests/sim/test_pcap.py. SHB/IDB/EPB envelopes now have exhaustive length/footer/alignment tests; IDB declares LINKTYPE_USER0, snaplen 65535, explicit 10^-6 timestamp resolution, interface name, and validated SF/BW/CR description. EPBs validate uint64 timestamps, bytes packets, snaplen, int32 signal fields, and bounded UTF-8 node IDs before any write; blocks are assembled before mutation; metadata uses the standard EPB comment option as bounded JSON; empty/max packets, padding, metadata, timestamp boundaries, invalid no-mutation cases, flush, idempotent close, init/body failure cleanup, and multiple blocks are covered. Validation: focused pcap plus NodeServer integration 56 passed, 1 skipped only because tshark is unavailable; Ruff format/check passed; mypy passed; diff check passed. Independent /usr/sbin/tcpdump read the generated PCAP-NG at timestamp 1.234567 with no structural or option warnings.
close_reason: Implemented robust standards-readable pcapng capture with validated bounded inputs, explicit timestamp/radio interface metadata, deterministic flush/close, and comprehensive block/edge tests; Python, Ruff, mypy, and tcpdump validation pass.
